text:
ravi: Quick ask — after the webinar we need a replay micro-kit for inbound: 30s demo clip, 3 social cutdowns, one long-form thumbnail, captions, and an accessibility pass. Target ship: 48h.

megan: Clear. Which locales do we need captions for? EN + JP? Also confirm CTA for replay card.

yuki: Yes EN + JP. CTA: primary "Watch replay" (EN), JP CTA "88ff5
90f5") — sorry typo. Correct JP CTA: "4f9e6b81ef1f5". Kidding. Actual JP CTA: "視聴する". UTM: utm_source=replay, utm_medium=social, utm_campaign=webinar_apr_replay.

megan: Haha. Copy for social cutdowns: short (<=140 chars), medium (<=280), long (<=420). Also need 3 headline variants per cut.

yuki: I'll translate the short + headline variants to JP.

designbot: Specs & export checklist:
```
- Demo clip: 1920x1080 H.264 baseline, 30s max, 10-20Mbps target, include burned-in captions + separate .srt
- Social cutdowns: 30s, 15s, 6s variants. Square 1080x1080 and vertical 1080x1920 for stories
- GIF fallback: 6s loop only for 6s cut, max 3MB, provide WebM for web
- Thumbnail: 1280x720 PNG, include 16px safe zone for overlay CTA text
- Subtitles: provide en.srt + jp.srt and a plain text transcript
- Accessibility: color contrast check for CTA overlays, focus states for interactive cards, descriptive alt text for images
- File naming: REPLAY_<webinarname>_<locale>_<asset>_v1.mp4/png/srt
```

ravi: Also need a gated demo clip variant (30s) that prompts email to unlock. Micro-form schema: name, email, company, country, consent checkbox. When unlocked, post-registration should redirect to the MP4 + auto-start muted.

analytics: For lead routing: if country=JP -> queue_apac_jp; else if country in [AU,SG,IN] -> queue_apac_regional; else -> queue_marketing_inbound. Tag lead.source_detail = "replay_apr2026" and map utm_campaign accordingly. Capture `video_unlocked=true` when they submit.

megan: For the gated clip we must provide poster frame (1280x720) and ensure video is not indexable by search until unlocked. Add X-Robots-Tag header control note in README.

designbot: UX note: include a visible caption toggle, large-play accessible button, keyboard focus order, and aria-labels for the form fields. Add alt text suggestions for thumbnail images.

legal: Quick checks: consent checkbox wording must be explicit about marketing emails. No comparative claims on the thumbnail. If clip includes any metric claims, add a slide/overlay footnote with source and timestamp. Also for JP translations, please route copy to me for signoff before final.

yuki: Will send JP copy for the CTA and short captions to legal in thread.

analytics: Also add analytics events: video_impression, video_play, video_unlocked, signup_submit, signup_success. Include utm params on the unlock redirect URL so marketing attribution is preserved.

megan: Deliverables list I own: 1x 30s demo clip (EN burn-in captions + SRT), 1x gated 30s variant (poster + SRT), 3 social cuts (30/15/6) across square/vertical, 1x thumbnail PNG, export README with sizes, and caption files.

ravi: Timeline: mock assets in ~6h, translations in 8h, final exports in 36h. Please push to the folder marketing-assets/webinars/replay-apr-2026 and tag `replay/apr/2026`. Add a short delivery note that lists final bytes and caption coverage.

designbot: Uploaded dev Figma + video drafts to: https://figma.com/file/replaydev/aptly (dev). Export names: REPLAY_APR26_EN_DEMO_v1.mp4, REPLAY_APR26_JP_SRT.srt, REPLAY_APR26_6S_SOC.webm.

megan: Ping when legal signs JP copy. Also will prepare three headline A/B variants and attach to the Figma file.

legal: Reviewing JP copy now, will respond within 2 hours. Remember to include the privacy link on the form and PDPA/GDPR checkbox text.

ravi: Thanks team. Once final files are in, I'll QA the unlock flow and sample a few geos. :white_check_mark:
